author: IzaakWN
body:
Updating several list:

- Add new TAU POG L2 (@pmastrap) to `tau-pog`.
- Add new HGCal DPG L3s (@camendola, @cramonal, @waredjeb) to `hgcal-dpg` and remove @cseez & @rovere.
- Change `tau-pog` to `cms/tau-pog-l2`  in watchlist (because we were not notified for PR https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51885)
- Add @felicepantaleo & @IzaakWN as watchers of the new TruthInfo/TruthGraph modules.
title: Update tau-pog & hgcal-dpg; add TruthInfo/TruthGraph watchers
